buildCommand: npx expo export --platform web && cp public/sw.js dist/sw.js && cp public/manifest.json dist/manifest.json && cp assets/icon.png dist/icon-192.png && cp assets/icon.png dist/icon-512.png && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const html=fs.readFileSync('dist/index.html','utf8');fs.writeFileSync('dist/index.html',html.replace('</head>','<link rel=\"manifest\" href=\"/manifest.json\"/><meta name=\"theme-color\" content=\"#E8B54A\"/></head>'))"
